metadata.agent_last_message:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented a complete G-code simulator according to the RS274/NGC specification. Here's what I built:

## Implementation Summary

### **Core Simulator** (`output/main.js`)
A comprehensive ~2000-line JavaScript implementation that includes:

#### **Parsing & Execution**
- Full G-code lexer/parser handling comments, expressions, parameters, and block delete
- Expression evaluator with all RS274 operators and functions (arithmetic, trigonometric, logical)
- Order-of-execution following RS274 Table 8

#### **Motion Commands**
- **G0** - Rapid linear motion (1000 in/min)
- **G1** - Linear feed motion
- **G2/G3** - Circular/helical arcs (both radius and center format)
- **G38.2** - Straight probe with configurable probe box
- **G4** - Dwell

#### **Canned Cycles** (G81-G89)
All cycles with proper sub-motion expansion:
- G81 (drill), G82 (drill with dwell), G83 (peck drill)
- G84 (tapping), G85/G89 (boring variations)
- G86 (boring with spindle stop), G87 (back boring), G88 (boring with manual retract)

#### **Coordinate Systems**
- Nine program coordinate systems (G54-G59.3)
- G92 axis offsets (G92, G92.1, G92.2, G92.3)
- G53 absolute coordinates
- G10 L2 origin setting
- Full parameter storage (5220-5386)

#### **Tool Management**
- Tool table loading (RS274 section 2.3 format)
- T word tool selection, M6 tool change
- G43/G49 tool length offset with H words
- G41/G42/G40 cutter radius compensation with D words

#### **Feed & Spindle Control**
- G93 inverse time mode, G94 units/minute mode
- F word feed rate, S word spindle speed
- M3/M4/M5 spindle control (CW/CCW/OFF)
- M7/M8/M9 coolant control

#### **Program Control**
- G28/G30 home positioning (two-move sequence)
- M0/M1/M2/M30/M60 program stops
- M2/M30 program end with full state reset
- Parameter files (load/save)

#### **Trace Generation**
- Initial state snapshot
- Motion sampling (time-step, distance-step, or tolerance modes)
- Position tracking with line numbers and timing
- State-o
